+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""A clean-room Python port of the eza behavior used by this benchmark.
+
+The implementation follows the checked-in Rust source.  It intentionally uses
+only Python's standard library and never invokes the reference executable.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import calendar
+import datetime as _dt
+import fnmatch
+import functools
+import json
+import math
+import ntpath
+import os
+import shutil
+import stat

+import unicodedata

+
+

+    "eza - A modern, maintained replacement for ls\n"
+    "v0.23.3 [+git]\n"
+    "https://github.com/eza-community/eza\n"
+)
+
+SORT_CHOICES = (
+    "name", "Name", "size", "extension", "Extension", "modified",
+    "changed", "accessed", "created", "inode", "type", "none",
+)
+WHEN = ("always", "auto", "never")
+
+
+HELP = """Usage:
+  eza [options] [files...]
+
+META OPTIONS
+  -?, --help                 show list of command-line options
+  -v, --version              show version of eza
+
+DISPLAY OPTIONS
+  -1, --oneline              display one entry per line
+  -l, --long                 display extended file metadata as a table
+  -G, --grid                 display entries as a grid (default)
+  -x, --across               sort the grid across, rather than downwards
+  -R, --recurse              recurse into directories
+  -T, --tree                 recurse into directories as a tree
+  -X, --dereference          dereference symbolic links when displaying information
+  -F, --classify=WHEN        display type indicator by file names (always, auto, never)
+  --colo[u]r=WHEN            when to use terminal colours (always, auto, never)
+  --colo[u]r-scale           highlight levels of 'field' distinctly(all, age, size)
+  --colo[u]r-scale-mode      use gradient or fixed colors in --color-scale (fixed, gradient)
+  --icons=WHEN               when to display icons (always, auto, never)
+  --no-quotes                don't quote file names with spaces
+  --hyperlink                display entries as hyperlinks
+  --absolute                 display entries with their absolute path (on, follow, off)
+  --follow-symlinks          drill down into symbolic links that point to directories
+  -w, --width COLS           set screen width in columns
+
+
+FILTERING AND SORTING OPTIONS
+  -a, --all                  show hidden and 'dot' files. Use this twice to also
+                             show the '.' and '..' directories
+  -A, --almost-all           equivalent to --all; included for compatibility with `ls -A`
+  -d, --treat-dirs-as-files  list directories as files; don't list their contents
+  -D, --only-dirs            list only directories
+  -f, --only-files           list only files
+  --show-symlinks            explicitly show symbolic links (for use with --only-dirs | --only-files)
+  --no-symlinks              do not show symbolic links
+  -L, --level DEPTH          limit the depth of recursion
+  -r, --reverse              reverse the sort order
+  -s, --sort SORT_FIELD      which field to sort by
+  --group-directories-first  list directories before other files
+  --group-directories-last   list directories after other files
+  -I, --ignore-glob GLOBS    glob patterns (pipe-separated) of files to ignore
+  --git-ignore               ignore files mentioned in '.gitignore'
+  Valid sort fields:         name, Name, extension, Extension, size, type,
+                             created, modified, accessed, changed, inode, and none.
+                             date, time, old, and new all refer to modified.
+
+LONG VIEW OPTIONS
+  -b, --binary               list file sizes with binary prefixes
+  -B, --bytes                list file sizes in bytes, without any prefixes
+  -g, --group                list each file's group
+  --smart-group              only show group if it has a different name from owner
+  -h, --header               add a header row to each column
+  -H, --links                list each file's number of hard links
+  -i, --inode                list each file's inode number
+  -M, --mounts               show mount details (Linux and Mac only)
+  -n, --numeric              list numeric user and group IDs
+  -O, --flags                list file flags (Mac, BSD, and Windows only)
+  -S, --blocksize            show size of allocated file system blocks
+  -t, --time FIELD           which timestamp field to list (modified, accessed, created)
+  -m, --modified             use the modified timestamp field
+  -u, --accessed             use the accessed timestamp field
+  -U, --created              use the created timestamp field
+  --changed                  use the changed timestamp field
+  --time-style               how to format timestamps (default, iso, long-iso,
+                             full-iso, relative, or a custom style '+<FORMAT>'
+                             like '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
+  --total-size               show the size of a directory as the size of all
+                             files and directories inside (unix only)
+  -o, --octal-permissions    list each file's permission in octal format
+  --no-permissions           suppress the permissions field
+  --no-filesize              suppress the filesize field
+  --no-user                  suppress the user field
+  --no-time                  suppress the time field
+  --stdin                    read file names from stdin, one per line or other separator 
+                             specified in environment
+  --git                      list each file's Git status, if tracked or ignored
+  --no-git                   suppress Git status (always overrides --git,
+                             --git-repos, --git-repos-no-status)
+  --git-repos                list root of git-tree status
+  --git-repos-no-status      list each git-repos branch name (much faster)
+    
+"""
+
+
+class CliError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, suggestion: Optional[str] = None):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.message = message
+        self.suggestion = suggestion
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ArgSpec:
+    long: str
+    short: Optional[str] = None
+    takes: str = "forbidden"  # forbidden, necessary, optional
+    choices: Optional[tuple[str, ...]] = None
+    default: Optional[str] = None
+
+    def display(self) -> str:
+        return f"--{self.long}" + (f" (-{self.short})" if self.short else "")
+
+
+def _specs() -> list[ArgSpec]:
+    s = ArgSpec
+    return [
+        s("version", "v"), s("help", "?"),
+        s("oneline", "1"), s("long", "l"), s("grid", "G"), s("across", "x"),
+        s("recurse", "R"), s("tree", "T"),
+        s("classify", "F", "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        s("dereference", "X"), s("width", "w", "necessary"), s("no-quotes"),
+        s("absolute", None, "optional", ("on", "follow", "off"), "on"),
+        s("follow-symlinks"),
+        s("color", None, "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        s("colour", None, "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        s("color-scale", None, "optional", ("all", "size", "age"), "all"),
+        s("colour-scale", None, "optional", ("all", "size", "age"), "all"),
+        s("color-scale-mode", None, "necessary", ("fixed", "gradient")),
+        s("colour-scale-mode", None, "necessary", ("fixed", "gradient")),
+        s("all", "a"), s("almost-all", "A"), s("treat-dirs-as-files", "d"),
+        s("list-dirs"), s("level", "L", "necessary"), s("reverse", "r"),
+        s("sort", "s", "necessary", SORT_CHOICES),
+        s("ignore-glob", "I", "necessary"), s("git-ignore"),
+        s("group-directories-first"), s("group-directories-last"),
+        s("only-dirs", "D"), s("only-files", "f"), s("no-symlinks"),
+        s("show-symlinks"),
+        s("binary", "b"), s("bytes", "B"), s("group", "g"), s("numeric", "n"),
+        s("header", "h"), s("icons", None, "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        s("inode", "i"), s("links", "H"), s("modified", "m"), s("changed"),
+        s("blocksize", "S"), s("total-size"),
+        s("time", "t", "necessary", ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created")),
+        s("accessed", "u"), s("created", "U"),
+        s("time-style", None, "necessary", ("default", "long-iso", "full-iso", "iso", "relative")),
+        s("hyperlink"), s("mounts", "M"), s("smart-group"),
+        s("no-permissions"), s("no-filesize"), s("no-user"), s("no-time"),
+        s("git"), s("no-git"), s("git-repos"), s("git-repos-no-status"),
+        s("extended", "@"), s("octal-permissions", "o"), s("context", "Z"),
+        s("stdin"), s("flags", "O"),
+    ]
+
+
+SPECS = _specs()
+BY_LONG = {x.long: x for x in SPECS}
+BY_SHORT = {x.short: x for x in SPECS if x.short is not None}
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Occurrence:
+    spec: ArgSpec
+    spelling: str
+    value: Optional[str]
+    order: int
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Matches:
+    flags: list[Occurrence]
+    frees: list[str]
+
+    def occurrences(self, *names: str) -> list[Occurrence]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        return [f for f in self.flags if f.spec.long in wanted]
+
+    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        return any(f.spec.long == name for f in self.flags)
+
+    def count(self, name: str) -> int:
+        return sum(f.spec.long == name for f in self.flags)
+
+    def get(self, *names: str) -> Optional[str]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        for f in reversed(self.flags):
+            if f.spec.long in wanted and f.value is not None:
+                return f.value
+        return None
+
+    def last_flag(self, *names: str) -> Optional[Occurrence]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        for f in reversed(self.flags):
+            if f.spec.long in wanted:
+                return f
+        return None
+
+
+def _choices_text(values: Optional[tuple[str, ...]]) -> str:
+    return "" if values is None else " (choices: " + ", ".join(values) + ")"
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Matches:
+    flags: list[Occurrence] = []
+    frees: list[str] = []
+    parsing = True
+    i = 0
+    order = 0
+
+    def add(spec: ArgSpec, spelling: str, value: Optional[str]) -> None:
+        nonlocal order
+        flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, value, order))
+        order += 1
+
+    while i < len(argv):
+        raw = argv[i]
+        i += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            frees.append(raw)
+            continue
+        if raw == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if raw.startswith("--"):
+            body = raw[2:]
+            before = after = None
+            if "=" in body:
+                a, b = body.split("=", 1)
+                if a and b:
+                    before, after = a, b
+            if before is not None:
+                spec = BY_LONG.get(before)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise CliError(f"Unknown argument --{before}")
+                spelling = f"--{spec.long}"
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise CliError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                add(spec, spelling, after)
+                continue
+            spec = BY_LONG.get(body)
+            if spec is None:
+                raise CliError(f"Unknown argument --{body}")
+            spelling = f"--{spec.long}"
+            if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                add(spec, spelling, None)
+            elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                if i >= len(argv):
+                    suggestion = None
+                    if spec.short == "t":
+                        suggestion = 'To sort newest files last, try "--sort newest", or just "-snew"'
+                    raise CliError(
+                        f"Flag {spelling} needs a value" + _choices_text(spec.choices), suggestion
+                    )
+                add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                i += 1
+            else:
+                if i < len(argv) and spec.choices is not None and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                    add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                    i += 1
+                else:
+                    add(spec, spelling, spec.default)
+            continue
+        if raw.startswith("-") and raw != "-":
+            body = raw[1:]
+            split = None
+            if "=" in body:
+                a, b = body.split("=", 1)
+                if a and b:
+                    split = (a, b)
+            if split is not None:
+                before, value = split
+                others, valued = before[:-1], before[-1]
+                for ch in others:
+                    spec = BY_SHORT.get(ch)
+                    if spec is None:
+                        raise CliError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                    if spec.takes == "necessary":
+                        raise CliError(f"Flag -{ch} needs a value" + _choices_text(spec.choices))
+                    add(spec, f"-{ch}", spec.default if spec.takes == "optional" else None)
+                spec = BY_SHORT.get(valued)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise CliError(f"Unknown argument -{valued}")
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise CliError(f"Flag -{valued} cannot take a value")
+                add(spec, f"-{valued}", value)
+                continue
+            pos = 0
+            while pos < len(body):
+                ch = body[pos]
+                spec = BY_SHORT.get(ch)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise CliError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                spelling = f"-{ch}"
+                remainder = body[pos + 1:]
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    add(spec, spelling, None)
+                    pos += 1
+                    continue
+                if spec.takes == "necessary":
+                    if remainder:
+                        add(spec, spelling, remainder)
+                    elif i < len(argv):
+                        add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        suggestion = None
+                        if ch == "t":
+                            suggestion = 'To sort newest files last, try "--sort newest", or just "-snew"'
+                        raise CliError(
+                            f"Flag {spelling} needs a value" + _choices_text(spec.choices), suggestion
+                        )
+                    break
+                if remainder:
+                    if spec.choices is not None and remainder in spec.choices:
+                        add(spec, spelling, remainder)
+                    else:
+                        raise CliError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                    break
+                if i < len(argv) and spec.choices is not None and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                    add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                    i += 1
+                else:
+                    add(spec, spelling, spec.default)
+                pos += 1
+            continue
+        frees.append(raw)
+    return Matches(flags, frees)
+
+
+def _debug_string(value: str) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+
+def _bad_setting(spec: ArgSpec, value: str) -> CliError:
+    suffix = _choices_text(spec.choices) if spec.takes == "necessary" else ""
+    return CliError(f"Option {spec.display()} has no {_debug_string(value)} setting{suffix}")
+
+
+def _parse_uint(value: str, spec: ArgSpec) -> int:
+    try:
+        if not value or value.startswith(("+", "-")) or not value.isdecimal():
+            raise ValueError
+        return int(value, 10)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise CliError(
+            f"Value {_debug_string(value)} not valid for option {spec.display()}: invalid digit found in string"
+        ) from None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Config:
+    matches: Matches
+    mode: str
+    table: bool
+    width: Optional[int]
+    across: bool
+    tree: bool
+    recurse: bool
+    as_file: bool
+    level: Optional[int]
+    sort: str
+    reverse: bool
+    dirs_first: bool
+    dirs_last: bool
+    dot_mode: int
+    ignore_patterns: list[str]
+    only_dirs: bool
+    only_files: bool
+    no_symlinks: bool
+    show_symlinks: bool
+    follow_links: bool
+    deref_links: bool
+    no_quotes: bool
+    classify: str
+    absolute: str
+    header: bool
+    permissions: bool
+    filesize: bool
+    file_flags: bool
+    size_format: str
+    time_kinds: list[str]
+    time_style: str
+
+
+def deduce(matches: Matches) -> Config:
+    width: Optional[int] = None
+    width_word = matches.get("width")
+    if width_word is not None:
+        w = _parse_uint(width_word, BY_LONG["width"])
+        if w >= 1:
+            width = w
+        elif sys.stdout.isatty():
+            width = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24)).columns
+    elif "COLUMNS" in os.environ:
+        word = os.environ["COLUMNS"]
+        try:
+            if not word or word.startswith(("+", "-")) or not word.isdecimal():
+                raise ValueError
+            width = int(word)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise CliError(
+                f"Value {_debug_string(word)} not valid for environment variable COLUMNS: invalid digit found in string"
+            ) from None
+    elif sys.stdout.isatty():
+        width = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24)).columns
+
+    last_mode = matches.last_flag("long", "oneline", "grid", "tree")
+    table = False
+    if last_mode is None:
+        mode = "grid" if width is not None else "lines"
+    elif (
+        last_mode.spec.long == "long"
+        or (last_mode.spec.long == "tree" and matches.has("long"))
+        or (last_mode.spec.long == "grid" and matches.has("long"))
+    ):
+        table = True
+        last_grid_tree = matches.last_flag("grid", "tree")
+        mode = "grid-details" if last_grid_tree and last_grid_tree.spec.long == "grid" else "details"
+    elif last_mode.spec.long == "tree":
+        mode = "details"
+    elif last_mode.spec.long == "oneline":
+        mode = "lines"
+    else:
+        mode = "grid"
+
+    can_tree = mode == "details"
+    has_tree = matches.has("tree")
+    recurse_flag = matches.has("recurse")
+    as_file_flag = matches.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or matches.has("list-dirs")
+    tree = has_tree and can_tree
+    recurse = tree or (not tree and recurse_flag)
+    as_file = not recurse and as_file_flag
+    level = None
+    if recurse:
+        level_word = matches.get("level")
+        if level_word is not None:
+            level = _parse_uint(level_word, BY_LONG["level"])
+
+    all_count = matches.count("all")
+    almost = matches.has("almost-all")
+    if all_count >= 2 and matches.has("tree"):
+        raise CliError("Option --tree is useless given --all --all")
+    if all_count >= 2:
+        dot_mode = 2
+    elif all_count == 1 or almost:
+        dot_mode = 1
+    else:
+        dot_mode = 0
+
+    sort_word = matches.get("sort") or "name"
+    sort_aliases = {
+        "filename": "name", "Filename": "Name", ".filename": ".name",
+        ".Filename": ".Name", "filesize": "size", "ext": "extension",
+        "Ext": "Extension", "date": "modified", "time": "modified",
+        "mod": "modified", "new": "modified", "newest": "modified",

+def _path_filename(path: str) -> str:
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return path
+    stripped = path.rstrip("\\/")
+    if not stripped:
+        return path
+    name = ntpath.basename(stripped)
+    return name if name else stripped
+
+
+def _raw_parent(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return None
+    stripped = path.rstrip("\\/")
+    idx = max(stripped.rfind("\\"), stripped.rfind("/"))
+    if idx < 0:
+        return None
+    parent = stripped[:idx]
+    if idx == 2 and len(stripped) >= 3 and stripped[1] == ":":
+        parent = stripped[:3]
+    return parent or None
+

+def _join(parent: str, child: str) -> str:
+    return ntpath.join(parent, child)

+@dataclass
+class FileEntry:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    direct: bool = False
+    is_all_all: bool = False
+    _stat: Optional[os.stat_result] = field(default=None, repr=False)
+
+    def lstat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        if self._stat is None:
+            self._stat = os.lstat(self.path)
+        return self._stat
+
+    def attributes(self) -> int:
+        st = self.lstat()
+        attrs = getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", None)
+        if attrs is not None:
+            return int(attrs)
+        value = 0
+        if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
+            value |= 0x10
+        elif stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+            value |= 0x20
+        if not os.access(self.path, os.W_OK):
+            value |= 0x1
+        return value
+
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat().st_mode) or bool(self.attributes() & 0x400)
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISDIR(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISREG(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def points_to_dir(self) -> bool:
+        if self.is_dir():
+            return True
+        if self.is_link():
+            try:
+                return os.path.isdir(self.path)
+            except OSError:
+                return False
+        return False
+
+    def length(self) -> int:
+        try:
+            return int(self.lstat().st_size)
+        except OSError:
+            return 0
+
+    def extension(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        pos = self.name.rfind(".")
+        return self.name[pos + 1:].lower() if pos >= 0 else None
+

+def _io_error(error: OSError) -> str:
+    number = getattr(error, "winerror", None)
+    if number is None:
+        number = error.errno
+    text = error.strerror or str(error)
+    return f"{text} (os error {number})" if number is not None else text

+def _is_hidden(entry: FileEntry) -> bool:

+def read_children(path: str, cfg: Config) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    children: list[FileEntry] = []
+    if cfg.dot_mode == 2:
+        children.append(FileEntry(path, ".", is_all_all=True))
+        children.append(FileEntry(_join(path, ".."), "..", is_all_all=True))
+    with os.scandir(path) as scan:
+        for de in scan:
+            child = FileEntry(_join(path, de.name), de.name)
+            if cfg.dot_mode == 0 and _is_hidden(child):

+def _ignored(entry: FileEntry, cfg: Config) -> bool:

+def filter_children(entries: list[FileEntry], cfg: Config, recursing: bool) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    out = [e for e in entries if not _ignored(e, cfg)]
+    kept: list[FileEntry] = []
+    for e in out:
+        if cfg.only_dirs and not cfg.only_files:
+            if cfg.show_symlinks:
+                ok = e.is_dir() or e.points_to_dir()
+            else:
+                ok = e.is_dir()
+        elif cfg.only_files and not cfg.only_dirs:
+            if recursing:
+                ok = True
+            elif cfg.show_symlinks:
+                ok = e.is_file() or (e.is_link() and not e.points_to_dir())
+            else:
+                ok = e.is_file()
+        elif cfg.no_symlinks and not cfg.show_symlinks:
+            ok = not e.is_link()
+        else:
+            ok = True
+        if ok:
+            kept.append(e)
+    return kept

+def _natural_chunks(value: str) -> list[tuple[int, object, object]]:
+    chunks: list[tuple[int, object, object]] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(value):
+        if value[i].isdigit():
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(value) and value[j].isdigit():
+                j += 1
+            raw = value[i:j]
+            significant = raw.lstrip("0") or "0"
+            chunks.append((1, len(significant), significant))
+            i = j
+        else:
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(value) and not value[j].isdigit():
+                j += 1
+            chunks.append((0, value[i:j], ""))
+            i = j
+    return chunks
+

+def _natcmp(a: str, b: str, ignore_case: bool) -> int:
+    if ignore_case:
+        a = a.lower()
+        b = b.lower()
+    ac = _natural_chunks(a)
+    bc = _natural_chunks(b)
+    for x, y in zip(ac, bc):
+        if x[0] != y[0]:
+            # natord ultimately falls back to lexical ordering at a type boundary.
+            sx = str(x[1])
+            sy = str(y[1])
+            if sx != sy:
+                return -1 if sx < sy else 1
+        elif x[1:] != y[1:]:
+            return -1 if x[1:] < y[1:] else 1
+    if len(ac) != len(bc):
+        return -1 if len(ac) < len(bc) else 1
+    return 0
+

+def _timestamp_ns(entry: FileEntry, kind: str, deref: bool = False) -> Optional[int]:
+    try:
+        st = os.stat(entry.path) if deref and entry.is_link() else entry.lstat()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    if kind in ("modified", "changed"):
+        return int(st.st_mtime_ns)
+    if kind == "accessed":
+        return int(st.st_atime_ns)
+    # On Windows st_ctime is the creation time.  Newer Python also exposes birthtime.
+    if hasattr(st, "st_birthtime_ns"):
+        return int(st.st_birthtime_ns)
+    return int(st.st_ctime_ns)
+

+def _cmp_optional(a: object, b: object) -> int:
+    if a is None and b is None:
+        return 0
+    if a is None:
+        return -1
+    if b is None:
+        return 1
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)
+

+def compare_entries(a: FileEntry, b: FileEntry, cfg: Config) -> int:
+    field_name = cfg.sort
+    if field_name == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field_name in ("name", "Name", ".name", ".Name"):
+        an, bn = a.name, b.name
+        if field_name.startswith("."):
+            an = an[1:] if an.startswith(".") else an
+            bn = bn[1:] if bn.startswith(".") else bn
+        return _natcmp(an, bn, field_name in ("name", ".name"))
+    if field_name == "size":
+        return _cmp_optional(a.length(), b.length())
+    if field_name in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "age"):
+        kind = "modified" if field_name == "age" else field_name
+        result = _cmp_optional(_timestamp_ns(a, kind), _timestamp_ns(b, kind))
+        return -result if field_name == "age" else result
+    if field_name in ("extension", "Extension"):
+        result = _cmp_optional(a.extension(), b.extension())
+        if result:
+            return result
+        return _natcmp(a.name, b.name, field_name == "extension")
+    if field_name == "type":
+        def rank(e: FileEntry) -> int:
+            if e.is_dir():
+                return 0
+            if e.is_file():
+                return 1
+            return 7
+        result = (rank(a) > rank(b)) - (rank(a) < rank(b))
+        return result or _natcmp(a.name, b.name, False)
+    return 0
+

+def sort_entries(entries: list[FileEntry], cfg: Config) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    result = list(entries)
+    result.sort(key=functools.cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: compare_entries(a, b, cfg)))
+    if cfg.reverse:
+        result.reverse()
+    if cfg.dirs_first:
+        result.sort(key=lambda e: not e.points_to_dir())
+    elif cfg.dirs_last:
+        result.sort(key=lambda e: e.points_to_dir())
+    return result

+def _escape_text(value: str, no_quotes: bool) -> str:
+    pieces: list[str] = []
+    for ch in value:
+        code = ord(ch)
+        if code >= 0x20 and code != 0x7F:
+            pieces.append(ch)
+        elif ch == "\n": pieces.append("\\n")
+        elif ch == "\r": pieces.append("\\r")
+        elif ch == "\t": pieces.append("\\t")
+        elif ch == "\0": pieces.append("\\0")
+        elif code <= 0xFF: pieces.append(f"\\x{code:02x}")
+        else: pieces.append(f"\\u{{{code:x}}}")
+    rendered = "".join(pieces)
+    if not no_quotes and (" " in value or "'" in value):
+        q = '"' if "'" in value else "'"
+        return q + rendered + q
+    return rendered
+

+def _clean_absolute(path: str, follow: bool) -> str:
+    if follow:
+        return os.path.realpath(path)
+    return ntpath.normpath(os.path.abspath(path))

+def _direct_display(path: str, name: str, no_quotes: bool) -> str:
+    parent = _raw_parent(path)
+    if parent:
+        return _escape_text(parent, no_quotes) + "\\" + _escape_text(name, no_quotes)
+    return _escape_text(name, no_quotes)

+def _class_char(entry: FileEntry) -> str:
+    if entry.is_dir():
+        return "/"
+    if entry.is_link():
+        return "@"
+    return ""

+def _classification_on(cfg: Config) -> bool:
+    return cfg.classify == "always" or cfg.classify in ("auto", "automatic") and cfg.width is not None

+def render_name(entry: FileEntry, cfg: Config, with_links: bool) -> str:
+    if cfg.absolute != "off":
+        display = _escape_text(_clean_absolute(entry.path, cfg.absolute == "follow"), cfg.no_quotes)
+    elif entry.direct:
+        display = _direct_display(entry.path, entry.name, cfg.no_quotes)
+    else:
+        display = _escape_text(entry.name, cfg.no_quotes)
+
+    classify = _classification_on(cfg)
+    if with_links and entry.is_link() and not cfg.deref_links:
+        try:
+            target = os.readlink(entry.path)
+            if ntpath.isabs(target):
+                resolved = target
+            else:
+                resolved = ntpath.join(ntpath.dirname(entry.path), target)
+            if os.path.exists(resolved):
+                target_name = _path_filename(target)
+                target_display = _direct_display(target, target_name, False)
+                if classify and os.path.isdir(resolved):
+                    target_display += "/"
+                return display + " -> " + target_display
+            return display + " -> " + _escape_text(target, cfg.no_quotes)
+        except OSError:
+            return display
+    if classify:
+        display += _class_char(entry)
+    return display

+def _format_size(size: Optional[int], mode: str) -> str:
+    if size is None:
+        return "-"
+    if mode == "bytes":
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    base = 1024 if mode == "binary" else 1000
+    symbols = ("", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi", "Ti", "Pi", "Ei", "Zi", "Yi") if mode == "binary" else (
+        "", "k", "M", "G", "T", "P", "E", "Z", "Y"
+    )
+    if size < base:
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    power = min(int(math.log(size, base)), len(symbols) - 1)
+    number = size / (base ** power)
+    if number < 10:
+        shown = f"{number:.1f}"
+    else:
+        shown = str(math.floor(number + 0.5))
+    return shown + symbols[power]
+

+def _fixed_offset() -> _dt.timedelta:
+    return _dt.datetime.now().astimezone().utcoffset() or _dt.timedelta(0)

+CURRENT_OFFSET = _fixed_offset()
+CURRENT_YEAR = _dt.datetime.now().year
+MONTHS = tuple(calendar.month_abbr[i] for i in range(1, 13))

+def _entry_datetime(entry: FileEntry, kind: str, cfg: Config) -> tuple[Optional[_dt.datetime], int]:
+    ns = _timestamp_ns(entry, kind, cfg.deref_links)
+    if ns is None or ns < 0:
+        return None, 0
+    seconds, nanos = divmod(ns, 1_000_000_000)
+    utc = _dt.datetime(1970, 1, 1) + _dt.timedelta(seconds=seconds, microseconds=nanos // 1000)
+    return utc + CURRENT_OFFSET, nanos
+
+
+def _relative_time(when: _dt.datetime) -> str:
+    now = _dt.datetime.utcnow() + CURRENT_OFFSET
+    seconds = max(0, int((now - when).total_seconds()))
+    units = ((31_536_000, "year"), (2_592_000, "month"), (604_800, "week"),
+             (86_400, "day"), (3_600, "hour"), (60, "minute"), (1, "second"))
+    for unit, name in units:
+        if seconds >= unit:
+            count = seconds // unit
+            return f"{count} {name}{'' if count == 1 else 's'}"
+    return "now"
+
+
+def _chrono_custom(dt: _dt.datetime, nanos: int, fmt: str) -> str:
+    marker = "__EZA_NANOS__"
+    fmt = fmt.replace("%f", marker).replace("%_d", f"{dt.day:2d}").replace("%e", f"{dt.day:2d}")
+    value = dt.strftime(fmt)
+    return value.replace(marker, f"{nanos:09d}")
+

+def _format_time(entry: FileEntry, kind: str, cfg: Config) -> str:
+    dt, nanos = _entry_datetime(entry, kind, cfg)
+    if dt is None:
+        return "-"
+    style = cfg.time_style
+    if style == "default":
+        month = MONTHS[dt.month - 1]
+        return f"{dt.day:2d} {month:<3} {dt:%H:%M}" if dt.year == CURRENT_YEAR else f"{dt.day:2d} {month:<3}  {dt.year:04d}"
+    if style == "iso":
+        return dt.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M") if dt.year == CURRENT_YEAR else dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+    if style == "long-iso":
+        return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+    if style == "full-iso":
+        total = int(CURRENT_OFFSET.total_seconds())
+        sign = "+" if total >= 0 else "-"
+        total = abs(total)
+        zone = f"{sign}{total // 3600:02d}{total % 3600 // 60:02d}"
+        return f"{dt:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}.{nanos:09d} {zone}"
+    if style == "relative":
+        return _relative_time(dt)
+    if style.startswith("+"):
+        lines = style[1:].splitlines()
+        fmt = lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 and dt.year == CURRENT_YEAR else (lines[0] if lines else "")
+        return _chrono_custom(dt, nanos, fmt)
+    return "-"
+

+                            suggestion = 'To sort newest files last, try "--sort newest", or just "-snew"'
+                        raise CliError(
+                            f"Flag {spelling} needs a value" + _choices_text(spec.choices), suggestion
+                        )
+                    break
+                if remainder:
+                    if spec.choices is not None and remainder in spec.choices:
+                        add(spec, spelling, remainder)
+                    else:
+                        raise CliError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                    break
+                if i < len(argv) and spec.choices is not None and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                    add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                    i += 1
+                else:
+                    add(spec, spelling, spec.default)
+                pos += 1
+            continue

+def deduce(matches: Matches) -> Config:
+    width: Optional[int] = None
+    width_word = matches.get("width")
+    if width_word is not None:
+        w = _parse_uint(width_word, BY_LONG["width"])
+        if w >= 1:
+            width = w
+        elif sys.stdout.isatty():
+            width = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24)).columns
+    elif "COLUMNS" in os.environ:
+        word = os.environ["COLUMNS"]
+        try:
+            if not word or word.startswith(("+", "-")) or not word.isdecimal():
+                raise ValueError
+            width = int(word)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise CliError(
+                f"Value {_debug_string(word)} not valid for environment variable COLUMNS: invalid digit found in string"
+            ) from None
+    elif sys.stdout.isatty():
+        width = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24)).columns
+
+    last_mode = matches.last_flag("long", "oneline", "grid", "tree")
+    table = False
+    if last_mode is None:
+        mode = "grid" if width is not None else "lines"
+    elif (
+        last_mode.spec.long == "long"
+        or (last_mode.spec.long == "tree" and matches.has("long"))
+        or (last_mode.spec.long == "grid" and matches.has("long"))
+    ):
+        table = True
+        last_grid_tree = matches.last_flag("grid", "tree")
+        mode = "grid-details" if last_grid_tree and last_grid_tree.spec.long == "grid" else "details"
+    elif last_mode.spec.long == "tree":
+        mode = "details"
+    elif last_mode.spec.long == "oneline":
+        mode = "lines"
+    else:
+        mode = "grid"
+
+    can_tree = mode == "details"
+    has_tree = matches.has("tree")
+    recurse_flag = matches.has("recurse")
+    as_file_flag = matches.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or matches.has("list-dirs")
+    tree = has_tree and can_tree
+    recurse = tree or (not tree and recurse_flag)
+    as_file = not recurse and as_file_flag
+    level = None
+    if recurse:
+        level_word = matches.get("level")
+        if level_word is not None:
+            level = _parse_uint(level_word, BY_LONG["level"])
+
+    all_count = matches.count("all")
+    almost = matches.has("almost-all")
+    if all_count >= 2 and matches.has("tree"):
+        raise CliError("Option --tree is useless given --all --all")
+    if all_count >= 2:
+        dot_mode = 2
+    elif all_count == 1 or almost:
+        dot_mode = 1
+    else:
+        dot_mode = 0
+
+    sort_word = matches.get("sort") or "name"
+    sort_aliases = {
+        "filename": "name", "Filename": "Name", ".filename": ".name",
+        ".Filename": ".Name", "filesize": "size", "ext": "extension",
+        "Ext": "Extension", "date": "modified", "time": "modified",
+        "mod": "modified", "new": "modified", "newest": "modified",
+        "age": "age", "old": "age", "oldest": "age",
+        "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created",
+    }
+    sort_word = sort_aliases.get(sort_word, sort_word)
+    valid_sorts = {
+        "name", "Name", ".name", ".Name", "size", "extension",
+        "Extension", "modified", "age", "changed", "accessed",
+        "created", "type", "none",
+    }
+    if sort_word not in valid_sorts:
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["sort"], matches.get("sort") or sort_word)
+
+    for color_name in ("color", "colour"):
+        value = matches.get(color_name)
+        if value is not None and value not in ("always", "auto", "automatic", "never"):
+            raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["color"], value)
+    icons = matches.get("icons")
+    if icons is not None and icons not in ("always", "auto", "automatic", "never"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["icons"], icons)
+    classify = matches.get("classify") or "never"
+    if classify not in ("always", "auto", "automatic", "never"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["classify"], classify)
+    absolute = matches.get("absolute") or "off"
+    absolute = {"yes": "on", "no": "off"}.get(absolute, absolute)
+    if absolute not in ("on", "follow", "off"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["absolute"], absolute)
+
+    size_last = matches.last_flag("binary", "bytes")
+    size_format = "decimal"
+    if size_last:
+        size_format = "binary" if size_last.spec.long == "binary" else "bytes"
+
+    no_time = matches.has("no-time")
+    time_kinds: list[str]
+    time_word = matches.get("time")
+    selected = [
+        k for k, flag in (
+            ("modified", "modified"), ("changed", "changed"),
+            ("created", "created"), ("accessed", "accessed"),
+        ) if matches.has(flag)
+    ]
+    if no_time:
+        time_kinds = []
+    elif time_word is not None:
+        aliases = {"mod": "modified", "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created"}
+        canonical = aliases.get(time_word, time_word)
+        if canonical not in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created"):
+            raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["time"], time_word)
+        if selected:
+            flag = selected[0]
+            raise CliError(f"Option {BY_LONG[flag].display()} is useless given option {BY_LONG['time'].display()}")
+        time_kinds = [canonical]
+    elif selected:
+        time_kinds = selected
+    else:
+        time_kinds = ["modified"]
+
+    time_style = matches.get("time-style") or os.environ.get("TIME_STYLE") or "default"
+    if table and time_style not in ("default", "relative", "iso", "long-iso", "full-iso") and not time_style.startswith("+"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["time-style"], time_style)
+
+    ignore_word = matches.get("ignore-glob")
+    ignore_patterns = ignore_word.split("|") if ignore_word is not None else []
+
+    return Config(
+        matches=matches, mode=mode, table=table, width=width,
+        across=matches.has("across"), tree=tree, recurse=recurse,
+        as_file=as_file, level=level, sort=sort_word,
+        reverse=matches.has("reverse"),
+        dirs_first=matches.has("group-directories-first"),
+        dirs_last=matches.has("group-directories-last"), dot_mode=dot_mode,
+        ignore_patterns=ignore_patterns, only_dirs=matches.has("only-dirs"),
+        only_files=matches.has("only-files"), no_symlinks=matches.has("no-symlinks"),
+        show_symlinks=matches.has("show-symlinks"),
+        follow_links=matches.has("follow-symlinks"),
+        deref_links=matches.has("dereference"), no_quotes=matches.has("no-quotes"),
+        classify=classify, absolute=absolute, header=matches.has("header"),
+        permissions=not matches.has("no-permissions"),
+        filesize=not matches.has("no-filesize"), file_flags=matches.has("flags"),
+        size_format=size_format, time_kinds=time_kinds, time_style=time_style,
+    )

+def _path_filename(path: str) -> str:
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return path
+    stripped = path.rstrip("\\/")
+    if not stripped:
+        return path
+    name = ntpath.basename(stripped)
+    return name if name else stripped
+
+
+def _raw_parent(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return None
+    stripped = path.rstrip("\\/")
+    idx = max(stripped.rfind("\\"), stripped.rfind("/"))
+    if idx < 0:
+        return None
+    parent = stripped[:idx]
+    if idx == 2 and len(stripped) >= 3 and stripped[1] == ":":
+        parent = stripped[:3]
+    return parent or None
+
+
+def _join(parent: str, child: str) -> str:
+    return ntpath.join(parent, child)

+@dataclass
+class FileEntry:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    direct: bool = False
+    is_all_all: bool = False
+    _stat: Optional[os.stat_result] = field(default=None, repr=False)
+
+    def lstat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        if self._stat is None:
+            self._stat = os.lstat(self.path)
+        return self._stat
+
+    def attributes(self) -> int:
+        st = self.lstat()
+        attrs = getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", None)
+        if attrs is not None:
+            return int(attrs)
+        value = 0
+        if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
+            value |= 0x10
+        elif stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+            value |= 0x20
+        if not os.access(self.path, os.W_OK):
+            value |= 0x1
+        return value
+
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat().st_mode) or bool(self.attributes() & 0x400)
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISDIR(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISREG(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def points_to_dir(self) -> bool:
+        if self.is_dir():
+            return True
+        if self.is_link():
+            try:
+                return os.path.isdir(self.path)
+            except OSError:
+                return False
+        return False
+
+    def length(self) -> int:
+        try:
+            return int(self.lstat().st_size)
+        except OSError:
+            return 0
+
+    def extension(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        pos = self.name.rfind(".")
+        return self.name[pos + 1:].lower() if pos >= 0 else None
+
+
+def _io_error(error: OSError) -> str:
+    number = getattr(error, "winerror", None)
+    if number is None:
+        number = error.errno
+    text = error.strerror or str(error)
+    return f"{text} (os error {number})" if number is not None else text

+def _is_hidden(entry: FileEntry) -> bool:
+    if entry.name.startswith((".", "_")):
+        return True
+    try:
+        return bool(entry.attributes() & 0x2)
+    except OSError:

+def read_children(path: str, cfg: Config) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    children: list[FileEntry] = []
+    if cfg.dot_mode == 2:
+        children.append(FileEntry(path, ".", is_all_all=True))
+        children.append(FileEntry(_join(path, ".."), "..", is_all_all=True))
+    with os.scandir(path) as scan:
+        for de in scan:
+            child = FileEntry(_join(path, de.name), de.name)
+            if cfg.dot_mode == 0 and _is_hidden(child):
+                continue
+            children.append(child)
+    return children

+def _ignored(entry: FileEntry, cfg: Config) -> bool:
+    return any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(entry.name, pattern) for pattern in cfg.ignore_patterns)
+
+
+def filter_children(entries: list[FileEntry], cfg: Config, recursing: bool) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    out = [e for e in entries if not _ignored(e, cfg)]
+    kept: list[FileEntry] = []
+    for e in out:
+        if cfg.only_dirs and not cfg.only_files:
+            if cfg.show_symlinks:
+                ok = e.is_dir() or e.points_to_dir()
+            else:
+                ok = e.is_dir()
+        elif cfg.only_files and not cfg.only_dirs:
+            if recursing:
+                ok = True
+            elif cfg.show_symlinks:
+                ok = e.is_file() or (e.is_link() and not e.points_to_dir())
+            else:
+                ok = e.is_file()
+        elif cfg.no_symlinks and not cfg.show_symlinks:
+            ok = not e.is_link()
+        else:
+            ok = True
+        if ok:
+            kept.append(e)
+    return kept

+def _natural_chunks(value: str) -> list[tuple[int, object, object]]:
+    chunks: list[tuple[int, object, object]] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(value):
+        if value[i].isdigit():
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(value) and value[j].isdigit():
+                j += 1
+            raw = value[i:j]
+            significant = raw.lstrip("0") or "0"
+            chunks.append((1, len(significant), significant))
+            i = j
+        else:
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(value) and not value[j].isdigit():
+                j += 1
+            chunks.append((0, value[i:j], ""))
+            i = j
+    return chunks
+
+
+def _natcmp(a: str, b: str, ignore_case: bool) -> int:
+    if ignore_case:
+        a = a.lower()
+        b = b.lower()
+    ac = _natural_chunks(a)
+    bc = _natural_chunks(b)
+    for x, y in zip(ac, bc):
+        if x[0] != y[0]:
+            # natord ultimately falls back to lexical ordering at a type boundary.
+            sx = str(x[1])
+            sy = str(y[1])
+            if sx != sy:
+                return -1 if sx < sy else 1
+        elif x[1:] != y[1:]:
+            return -1 if x[1:] < y[1:] else 1
+    if len(ac) != len(bc):
+        return -1 if len(ac) < len(bc) else 1
+    return 0
+

+def _timestamp_ns(entry: FileEntry, kind: str, deref: bool = False) -> Optional[int]:
+    try:
+        st = os.stat(entry.path) if deref and entry.is_link() else entry.lstat()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    if kind in ("modified", "changed"):
+        return int(st.st_mtime_ns)
+    if kind == "accessed":
+        return int(st.st_atime_ns)
+    # On Windows st_ctime is the creation time.  Newer Python also exposes birthtime.
+    if hasattr(st, "st_birthtime_ns"):
+        return int(st.st_birthtime_ns)
+    return int(st.st_ctime_ns)
+
+
+def _cmp_optional(a: object, b: object) -> int:
+    if a is None and b is None:
+        return 0
+    if a is None:
+        return -1
+    if b is None:
+        return 1
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)
+

+def compare_entries(a: FileEntry, b: FileEntry, cfg: Config) -> int:
+    field_name = cfg.sort
+    if field_name == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field_name in ("name", "Name", ".name", ".Name"):
+        an, bn = a.name, b.name
+        if field_name.startswith("."):
+            an = an[1:] if an.startswith(".") else an
+            bn = bn[1:] if bn.startswith(".") else bn
+        return _natcmp(an, bn, field_name in ("name", ".name"))
+    if field_name == "size":
+        return _cmp_optional(a.length(), b.length())
+    if field_name in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "age"):
+        kind = "modified" if field_name == "age" else field_name
+        result = _cmp_optional(_timestamp_ns(a, kind), _timestamp_ns(b, kind))
+        return -result if field_name == "age" else result
+    if field_name in ("extension", "Extension"):
+        result = _cmp_optional(a.extension(), b.extension())
+        if result:
+            return result
+        return _natcmp(a.name, b.name, field_name == "extension")
+    if field_name == "type":
+        def rank(e: FileEntry) -> int:
+            if e.is_dir():
+                return 0
+            if e.is_file():
+                return 1
+            return 7
+        result = (rank(a) > rank(b)) - (rank(a) < rank(b))
+        return result or _natcmp(a.name, b.name, False)
+    return 0
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries: list[FileEntry], cfg: Config) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    result = list(entries)
+    result.sort(key=functools.cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: compare_entries(a, b, cfg)))
+    if cfg.reverse:
+        result.reverse()
+    if cfg.dirs_first:
+        result.sort(key=lambda e: not e.points_to_dir())
+    elif cfg.dirs_last:
+        result.sort(key=lambda e: e.points_to_dir())
+    return result

+def _escape_text(value: str, no_quotes: bool) -> str:
+    pieces: list[str] = []
+    for ch in value:
+        code = ord(ch)
+        if code >= 0x20 and code != 0x7F:
+            pieces.append(ch)
+        elif ch == "\n": pieces.append("\\n")
+        elif ch == "\r": pieces.append("\\r")
+        elif ch == "\t": pieces.append("\\t")
+        elif ch == "\0": pieces.append("\\0")
+        elif code <= 0xFF: pieces.append(f"\\x{code:02x}")
+        else: pieces.append(f"\\u{{{code:x}}}")
+    rendered = "".join(pieces)
+    if not no_quotes and (" " in value or "'" in value):
+        q = '"' if "'" in value else "'"
+        return q + rendered + q
+    return rendered
+

+def _clean_absolute(path: str, follow: bool) -> str:
+    if follow:
+        return os.path.realpath(path)
+    return ntpath.normpath(os.path.abspath(path))

+def _direct_display(path: str, name: str, no_quotes: bool) -> str:
+    parent = _raw_parent(path)
+    if parent:
+        return _escape_text(parent, no_quotes) + "\\" + _escape_text(name, no_quotes)
+    return _escape_text(name, no_quotes)

+def _class_char(entry: FileEntry) -> str:
+    if entry.is_dir():

+    if entry.is_link():

+def _classification_on(cfg: Config) -> bool:

+def render_name(entry: FileEntry, cfg: Config, with_links: bool) -> str:
+    if cfg.absolute != "off":
+        display = _escape_text(_clean_absolute(entry.path, cfg.absolute == "follow"), cfg.no_quotes)
+    elif entry.direct:
+        display = _direct_display(entry.path, entry.name, cfg.no_quotes)
+    else:
+        display = _escape_text(entry.name, cfg.no_quotes)
+
+    classify = _classification_on(cfg)
+    if with_links and entry.is_link() and not cfg.deref_links:
+        try:
+            target = os.readlink(entry.path)
+            if ntpath.isabs(target):
+                resolved = target
+            else:
+                resolved = ntpath.join(ntpath.dirname(entry.path), target)
+            if os.path.exists(resolved):
+                target_name = _path_filename(target)
+                target_display = _direct_display(target, target_name, False)
+                if classify and os.path.isdir(resolved):
+                    target_display += "/"
+                return display + " -> " + target_display
+            return display + " -> " + _escape_text(target, cfg.no_quotes)
+        except OSError:
+            return display
+    if classify:
+        display += _class_char(entry)
+    return display

+def _format_size(size: Optional[int], mode: str) -> str:
+    if size is None:
+        return "-"
+    if mode == "bytes":
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    base = 1024 if mode == "binary" else 1000
+    symbols = ("", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi", "Ti", "Pi", "Ei", "Zi", "Yi") if mode == "binary" else (
+        "", "k", "M", "G", "T", "P", "E", "Z", "Y"
+    )
+    if size < base:
+        return f"{size:,}"
+    power = min(int(math.log(size, base)), len(symbols) - 1)
+    number = size / (base ** power)
+    if number < 10:
+        shown = f"{number:.1f}"
+    else:
+        shown = str(math.floor(number + 0.5))
+    return shown + symbols[power]
+

+    return typ + ("a" if attrs & 0x20 else "-") + ("r" if attrs & 0x1 else "-") + (
+        "h" if attrs & 0x2 else "-"
+    ) + ("s" if attrs & 0x4 else "-")

+def _flags_string(entry: FileEntry) -> str:
+    try:
+        attrs = entry.attributes()
+    except OSError:

+@dataclass
+class Occurrence:
+    spec: ArgSpec
+    spelling: str
+    value: Optional[str]
+    order: int
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Matches:
+    flags: list[Occurrence]
+    frees: list[str]
+
+    def occurrences(self, *names: str) -> list[Occurrence]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        return [f for f in self.flags if f.spec.long in wanted]
+
+    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        return any(f.spec.long == name for f in self.flags)
+
+    def count(self, name: str) -> int:
+        return sum(f.spec.long == name for f in self.flags)
+
+    def get(self, *names: str) -> Optional[str]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        for f in reversed(self.flags):
+            if f.spec.long in wanted and f.value is not None:
+                return f.value
+        return None
+
+    def last_flag(self, *names: str) -> Optional[Occurrence]:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        for f in reversed(self.flags):
+            if f.spec.long in wanted:
+                return f
+        return None

+def _choices_text(values: Optional[tuple[str, ...]]) -> str:
+    return "" if values is None else " (choices: " + ", ".join(values) + ")"

+def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Matches:
+    flags: list[Occurrence] = []
+    frees: list[str] = []
+    parsing = True
+    i = 0
+    order = 0
+
+    def add(spec: ArgSpec, spelling: str, value: Optional[str]) -> None:
+        nonlocal order
+        flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, value, order))
+        order += 1
+
+    while i < len(argv):
+        raw = argv[i]
+        i += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            frees.append(raw)
+            continue
+        if raw == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if raw.startswith("--"):
+            body = raw[2:]
+            before = after = None
+            if "=" in body:
+                a, b = body.split("=", 1)
+                if a and b:
+                    before, after = a, b
+            if before is not None:
+                spec = BY_LONG.get(before)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise CliError(f"Unknown argument --{before}")
+                spelling = f"--{spec.long}"
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise CliError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                add(spec, spelling, after)
+                continue
+            spec = BY_LONG.get(body)
+            if spec is None:
+                raise CliError(f"Unknown argument --{body}")
+            spelling = f"--{spec.long}"
+            if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                add(spec, spelling, None)
+            elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                if i >= len(argv):
+                    suggestion = None
+                    if spec.short == "t":
+                        suggestion = 'To sort newest files last, try "--sort newest", or just "-snew"'
+                    raise CliError(
+                        f"Flag {spelling} needs a value" + _choices_text(spec.choices), suggestion
+                    )
+                add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                i += 1
+            else:
+                if i < len(argv) and spec.choices is not None and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                    add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                    i += 1
+                else:
+                    add(spec, spelling, spec.default)
+            continue
+        if raw.startswith("-") and raw != "-":
+            body = raw[1:]
+            split = None
+            if "=" in body:
+                a, b = body.split("=", 1)
+                if a and b:
+                    split = (a, b)
+            if split is not None:
+                before, value = split
+                others, valued = before[:-1], before[-1]
+                for ch in others:
+                    spec = BY_SHORT.get(ch)
+                    if spec is None:
+                        raise CliError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                    if spec.takes == "necessary":
+                        raise CliError(f"Flag -{ch} needs a value" + _choices_text(spec.choices))
+                    add(spec, f"-{ch}", spec.default if spec.takes == "optional" else None)
+                spec = BY_SHORT.get(valued)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise CliError(f"Unknown argument -{valued}")
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise CliError(f"Flag -{valued} cannot take a value")
+                add(spec, f"-{valued}", value)
+                continue
+            pos = 0
+            while pos < len(body):
+                ch = body[pos]
+                spec = BY_SHORT.get(ch)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise CliError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                spelling = f"-{ch}"
+                remainder = body[pos + 1:]
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    add(spec, spelling, None)
+                    pos += 1
+                    continue
+                if spec.takes == "necessary":
+                    if remainder:
+                        add(spec, spelling, remainder)
+                    elif i < len(argv):
+                        add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        suggestion = None
+                        if ch == "t":
+                            suggestion = 'To sort newest files last, try "--sort newest", or just "-snew"'
+                        raise CliError(
+                            f"Flag {spelling} needs a value" + _choices_text(spec.choices), suggestion
+                        )
+                    break
+                if remainder:
+                    if spec.choices is not None and remainder in spec.choices:
+                        add(spec, spelling, remainder)
+                    else:
+                        raise CliError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                    break
+                if i < len(argv) and spec.choices is not None and argv[i] in spec.choices:
+                    add(spec, spelling, argv[i])
+                    i += 1
+                else:
+                    add(spec, spelling, spec.default)
+                pos += 1
+            continue
+        frees.append(raw)
+    return Matches(flags, frees)

+def deduce(matches: Matches) -> Config:
+    width: Optional[int] = None
+    width_word = matches.get("width")
+    if width_word is not None:
+        w = _parse_uint(width_word, BY_LONG["width"])
+        if w >= 1:
+            width = w
+        elif sys.stdout.isatty():
+            width = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24)).columns
+    elif "COLUMNS" in os.environ:
+        word = os.environ["COLUMNS"]
+        try:
+            if not word or word.startswith(("+", "-")) or not word.isdecimal():
+                raise ValueError
+            width = int(word)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise CliError(
+                f"Value {_debug_string(word)} not valid for environment variable COLUMNS: invalid digit found in string"
+            ) from None
+    elif sys.stdout.isatty():
+        width = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24)).columns
+
+    last_mode = matches.last_flag("long", "oneline", "grid", "tree")
+    table = False
+    if last_mode is None:
+        mode = "grid" if width is not None else "lines"
+    elif (
+        last_mode.spec.long == "long"
+        or (last_mode.spec.long == "tree" and matches.has("long"))
+        or (last_mode.spec.long == "grid" and matches.has("long"))
+    ):
+        table = True
+        last_grid_tree = matches.last_flag("grid", "tree")
+        mode = "grid-details" if last_grid_tree and last_grid_tree.spec.long == "grid" else "details"
+    elif last_mode.spec.long == "tree":
+        mode = "details"
+    elif last_mode.spec.long == "oneline":
+        mode = "lines"
+    else:
+        mode = "grid"
+
+    can_tree = mode == "details"
+    has_tree = matches.has("tree")
+    recurse_flag = matches.has("recurse")
+    as_file_flag = matches.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or matches.has("list-dirs")
+    tree = has_tree and can_tree
+    recurse = tree or (not tree and recurse_flag)
+    as_file = not recurse and as_file_flag
+    level = None
+    if recurse:
+        level_word = matches.get("level")
+        if level_word is not None:
+            level = _parse_uint(level_word, BY_LONG["level"])
+
+    all_count = matches.count("all")
+    almost = matches.has("almost-all")
+    if all_count >= 2 and matches.has("tree"):
+        raise CliError("Option --tree is useless given --all --all")
+    if all_count >= 2:
+        dot_mode = 2
+    elif all_count == 1 or almost:
+        dot_mode = 1
+    else:
+        dot_mode = 0
+
+    sort_word = matches.get("sort") or "name"
+    sort_aliases = {
+        "filename": "name", "Filename": "Name", ".filename": ".name",
+        ".Filename": ".Name", "filesize": "size", "ext": "extension",
+        "Ext": "Extension", "date": "modified", "time": "modified",
+        "mod": "modified", "new": "modified", "newest": "modified",
+        "age": "age", "old": "age", "oldest": "age",
+        "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created",
+    }
+    sort_word = sort_aliases.get(sort_word, sort_word)
+    valid_sorts = {
+        "name", "Name", ".name", ".Name", "size", "extension",
+        "Extension", "modified", "age", "changed", "accessed",
+        "created", "type", "none",
+    }
+    if sort_word not in valid_sorts:
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["sort"], matches.get("sort") or sort_word)
+
+    for color_name in ("color", "colour"):
+        value = matches.get(color_name)
+        if value is not None and value not in ("always", "auto", "automatic", "never"):
+            raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["color"], value)
+    icons = matches.get("icons")
+    if icons is not None and icons not in ("always", "auto", "automatic", "never"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["icons"], icons)
+    classify = matches.get("classify") or "never"
+    if classify not in ("always", "auto", "automatic", "never"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["classify"], classify)
+    absolute = matches.get("absolute") or "off"
+    absolute = {"yes": "on", "no": "off"}.get(absolute, absolute)
+    if absolute not in ("on", "follow", "off"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["absolute"], absolute)
+
+    size_last = matches.last_flag("binary", "bytes")
+    size_format = "decimal"
+    if size_last:
+        size_format = "binary" if size_last.spec.long == "binary" else "bytes"
+
+    no_time = matches.has("no-time")
+    time_kinds: list[str]
+    time_word = matches.get("time")
+    selected = [
+        k for k, flag in (
+            ("modified", "modified"), ("changed", "changed"),
+            ("created", "created"), ("accessed", "accessed"),
+        ) if matches.has(flag)
+    ]
+    if no_time:
+        time_kinds = []
+    elif time_word is not None:
+        aliases = {"mod": "modified", "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created"}
+        canonical = aliases.get(time_word, time_word)
+        if canonical not in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created"):
+            raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["time"], time_word)
+        if selected:
+            flag = selected[0]
+            raise CliError(f"Option {BY_LONG[flag].display()} is useless given option {BY_LONG['time'].display()}")
+        time_kinds = [canonical]
+    elif selected:
+        time_kinds = selected
+    else:
+        time_kinds = ["modified"]
+
+    time_style = matches.get("time-style") or os.environ.get("TIME_STYLE") or "default"
+    if table and time_style not in ("default", "relative", "iso", "long-iso", "full-iso") and not time_style.startswith("+"):
+        raise _bad_setting(BY_LONG["time-style"], time_style)
+
+    ignore_word = matches.get("ignore-glob")
+    ignore_patterns = ignore_word.split("|") if ignore_word is not None else []
+
+    return Config(
+        matches=matches, mode=mode, table=table, width=width,
+        across=matches.has("across"), tree=tree, recurse=recurse,
+        as_file=as_file, level=level, sort=sort_word,
+        reverse=matches.has("reverse"),
+        dirs_first=matches.has("group-directories-first"),
+        dirs_last=matches.has("group-directories-last"), dot_mode=dot_mode,
+        ignore_patterns=ignore_patterns, only_dirs=matches.has("only-dirs"),
+        only_files=matches.has("only-files"), no_symlinks=matches.has("no-symlinks"),
+        show_symlinks=matches.has("show-symlinks"),
+        follow_links=matches.has("follow-symlinks"),
+        deref_links=matches.has("dereference"), no_quotes=matches.has("no-quotes"),
+        classify=classify, absolute=absolute, header=matches.has("header"),
+        permissions=not matches.has("no-permissions"),
+        filesize=not matches.has("no-filesize"), file_flags=matches.has("flags"),
+        size_format=size_format, time_kinds=time_kinds, time_style=time_style,
+    )
+

+def _path_filename(path: str) -> str:
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return path
+    stripped = path.rstrip("\\/")
+    if not stripped:
+        return path
+    name = ntpath.basename(stripped)
+    return name if name else stripped
+
+
+def _raw_parent(path: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    if path in (".", ".."):
+        return None
+    stripped = path.rstrip("\\/")
+    idx = max(stripped.rfind("\\"), stripped.rfind("/"))
+    if idx < 0:
+        return None
+    parent = stripped[:idx]
+    if idx == 2 and len(stripped) >= 3 and stripped[1] == ":":
+        parent = stripped[:3]
+    return parent or None
+
+
+def _join(parent: str, child: str) -> str:
+    return ntpath.join(parent, child)

+@dataclass
+class FileEntry:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    direct: bool = False
+    is_all_all: bool = False
+    _stat: Optional[os.stat_result] = field(default=None, repr=False)
+
+    def lstat(self) -> os.stat_result:
+        if self._stat is None:
+            self._stat = os.lstat(self.path)
+        return self._stat
+
+    def attributes(self) -> int:
+        st = self.lstat()
+        attrs = getattr(st, "st_file_attributes", None)
+        if attrs is not None:
+            return int(attrs)
+        value = 0
+        if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
+            value |= 0x10
+        elif stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+            value |= 0x20
+        if not os.access(self.path, os.W_OK):
+            value |= 0x1
+        return value
+
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISLNK(self.lstat().st_mode) or bool(self.attributes() & 0x400)
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISDIR(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISREG(self.lstat().st_mode) and not self.is_link()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def points_to_dir(self) -> bool:
+        if self.is_dir():
+            return True
+        if self.is_link():
+            try:
+                return os.path.isdir(self.path)
+            except OSError:
+                return False
+        return False
+
+    def length(self) -> int:
+        try:
+            return int(self.lstat().st_size)
+        except OSError:
+            return 0
+
+    def extension(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        pos = self.name.rfind(".")
+        return self.name[pos + 1:].lower() if pos >= 0 else None
+

+def _io_error(error: OSError) -> str:
+    number = getattr(error, "winerror", None)
+    if number is None:
+        number = error.errno
+    text = error.strerror or str(error)
+    return f"{text} (os error {number})" if number is not None else text

+def _is_hidden(entry: FileEntry) -> bool:
+    if entry.name.startswith((".", "_")):
+        return True
+    try:
+        return bool(entry.attributes() & 0x2)
+    except OSError:
+        return False

+def read_children(path: str, cfg: Config) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    children: list[FileEntry] = []
+    if cfg.dot_mode == 2:
+        children.append(FileEntry(path, ".", is_all_all=True))
+        children.append(FileEntry(_join(path, ".."), "..", is_all_all=True))
+    with os.scandir(path) as scan:
+        for de in scan:
+            child = FileEntry(_join(path, de.name), de.name)
+            if cfg.dot_mode == 0 and _is_hidden(child):
+                continue
+            children.append(child)
+    return children

+def _ignored(entry: FileEntry, cfg: Config) -> bool:
+    return any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(entry.name, pattern) for pattern in cfg.ignore_patterns)
+
+
+def filter_children(entries: list[FileEntry], cfg: Config, recursing: bool) -> list[FileEntry]:
+    out = [e for e in entries if not _ignored(e, cfg)]
+    kept: list[FileEntry] = []
+    for e in out:
+        if cfg.only_dirs and not cfg.only_files:
+            if cfg.show_symlinks:
+                ok = e.is_dir() or e.points_to_dir()
+            else:
+                ok = e.is_dir()
+        elif cfg.only_files and not cfg.only_dirs:
+            if recursing:
+                ok = True
+            elif cfg.show_symlinks:
+                ok = e.is_file() or (e.is_link() and not e.points_to_dir())
+            else:
+                ok = e.is_file()
+        elif cfg.no_symlinks and not cfg.show_symlinks:
+            ok = not e.is_link()
+        else:
+            ok = True
+        if ok:
+            kept.append(e)
+    return kept

+def _natural_chunks(value: str) -> list[tuple[int, object, object]]:
+    chunks: list[tuple[int, object, object]] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(value):
+        if value[i].isdigit():
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(value) and value[j].isdigit():
+                j += 1
+            raw = value[i:j]
+            significant = raw.lstrip("0") or "0"
+            chunks.append((1, len(significant), significant))
+            i = j
+        else:
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(value) and not value[j].isdigit():
+                j += 1
+            chunks.append((0, value[i:j], ""))
+            i = j
+    return chunks
+
+
+def _natcmp(a: str, b: str, ignore_case: bool) -> int:
+    if ignore_case:
+        a = a.lower()
+        b = b.lower()
+    ac = _natural_chunks(a)
+    bc = _natural_chunks(b)
+    for x, y in zip(ac, bc):
+        if x[0] != y[0]:
+            # natord ultimately falls back to lexical ordering at a type boundary.
+            sx = str(x[1])
+            sy = str(y[1])
+            if sx != sy:
+                return -1 if sx < sy else 1
+        elif x[1:] != y[1:]:
+            return -1 if x[1:] < y[1:] else 1
+    if len(ac) != len(bc):
+        return -1 if len(ac) < len(bc) else 1
+    return 0
+

+def _timestamp_ns(entry: FileEntry, kind: str, deref: bool = False) -> Optional[int]:
+    try:
+        st = os.stat(entry.path) if deref and entry.is_link() else entry.lstat()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    if kind in ("modified", "changed"):
+        return int(st.st_mtime_ns)
+    if kind == "accessed":
+        return int(st.st_atime_ns)
+    # On Windows st_ctime is the creation time.  Newer Python also exposes birthtime.
+    if hasattr(st, "st_birthtime_ns"):
+        return int(st.st_birthtime_ns)
+    return int(st.st_ctime_ns)
+

+def _cmp_optional(a: object, b: object) -> int:
+    if a is None and b is None:
+        return 0
+    if a is None:
+        return -1
+    if b is None:
+        return 1
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)

+def compare_entries(a: FileEntry, b: FileEntry, cfg: Config) -> int:
+    field_name = cfg.sort
+    if field_name == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field_name in ("name", "Name", ".name", ".Name"):
+        an, bn = a.name, b.name
+        if field_name.startswith("."):
+            an = an[1:] if an.startswith(".") else an
+            bn = bn[1:] if bn.startswith(".") else bn
+        return _natcmp(an, bn, field_name in ("name", ".name"))
+    if field_name == "size":
+        return _cmp_optional(a.length(), b.length())
+    if field_name in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "age"):
+        kind = "modified" if field_name == "age" else field_name
+        result = _cmp_optional(_timestamp_ns(a, kind), _timestamp_ns(b, kind))
+        return -result if field_name == "age" else result
+    if field_name in ("extension", "Extension"):
+        result = _cmp_optional(a.extension(), b.extension())
+        if result:
+            return result
+        return _natcmp(a.name, b.name, field_name == "extension")
+    if field_name == "type":
+        def rank(e: FileEntry) -> int:
+            if e.is_dir():
+                return 0
+            if e.is_file():
+                return 1
+            return 7
+        result = (rank(a) > rank(b)) - (rank(a) < rank(b))
+        return result or _natcmp(a.name, b.name, False)
+    return 0
+

+def sort_entries(entries: list[FileEntry], cfg: Config) -> list[FileEntry]:
